topic: Cancer Pain and WHO Analgesic Ladder
rejected: The 1995 paper stored in the app concludes the case series are too weak to judge the ladder and does not define the steps.

source.title: Effectiveness of the World Health Organization cancer pain relief guidelines: an integrative review
source.whyItFits: Explains the three-step WHO ladder, names paracetamol as step 1, codeine as step 2, and strong opioids as third-line, and reviews how effective the guidelines have been.
